title: What We Believe
subtitle: Our Doctrine and Faith
intro: We are a church founded on the Holy Scriptures, committed to the apostolic faith and the eternal principles of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

trinity.title: The Trinity
trinity.description: We believe that God is one in three manifestations: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.description: We believe in salvation through personal faith in Jesus Christ alone, not by human works.

healing.title: Divine Healing
healing.description: We believe in divine healing through God's promise for all who believe.

baptism.title: Baptism
baptism.description: We believe in baptism as a public confession of faith in the name of Jesus Christ.

predestination.title: Predestination
predestination.description: We believe in election and predestination by God's sovereignty.

secondComing.title: Second Coming
secondComing.description: We believe in Christ's physical return and the rapture of the church.

millennium.title: Millennial Kingdom
millennium.description: We believe in the future theocratic government of Christ for a thousand years.

restoration.title: Restoration
restoration.description: We believe in the restoration of early church faith through a prophetic messenger.

principles.title: Moral and Civil Principles
principles.science: Scientific advancement as a gift from God
principles.education: Right to education and employment without discrimination
principles.authority: Respect for governmental authority and national laws

history.title: Our History
history.founding: The work began when a recently ordained theology couple was sent to Chile as missionaries. After hearing God's call to Bolivia, they arrived in Santa Cruz de la Sierra on September 18, 1969.
history.growth: They started preaching in the humble neighborhood "El Lazareto," witnessing healings and miracles that attracted followers. The movement expanded across Bolivia and into Peru, Brazil, Chile, Argentina, and Paraguay.
history.persecution: The organization faced persecution from 1976-1979, including the temporary exile of its founder, but persevered through prayer.
history.recognition: Legally recognized through Supreme Resolution No. 188425 on September 8, 1978 by Bolivia's Ministry of Foreign Relations.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our spiritual mission is to bring people back to the "apostolic faith." Our members include students, teachers, merchants, and professionals working to contribute positively to society while pursuing spiritual growth.
